---

Fixed. The issue was that `type` was cast as `string`, but Drizzle's schema defines it as an enum with specific allowed values. TypeScript requires the type to match exactly.

**The fix:** Cast `type` to `SkillType` (the union of allowed enum values) instead of `string`. The type alias is local (not exported) because `"use server"` files can only export async functions.
